description: For a coach, to run at the start of a session with a client. Needs nothing but this phone. What you write in each step's notes stays with the run.
name: Session agenda

steps.description: One at a time, in the client's words. Do not comment yet.
steps.title: Last actions: what was done, and what was not

steps.description: Ask for it before the rest. Specific beats big: what did you do, on which day?
steps.title: What went well

steps.description: The thing itself, not the reason it is understandable. Note it.
steps.title: What got in the way

steps.description: Say each one back. If the client cannot say it in a sentence, it is too big.
steps.title: Next actions: two or three, in the client's words

steps.description: Between now and next time. Name a person, or say you will check back in a week.
steps.title: Support needed, and from whom
